falsification_conditions.condition: The primary risk proxy (SPX or BTC, whichever the engine tracks as the pattern anchor) closes the 14-day window with a cumulative return beyond +10% or below -10% versus today's close.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A double-digit directional close falsifies HOLD and UNKNOWN: the tape has resolved into a trend, so an indecision/hold call is wrong.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to bottom_2022_may_luna falls from 78% to below 50%, or price prints a new 30-day high while 7-day realized volatility is lower than the prior 30-day average (no capitulation vol spike).
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The Luna-bottom analogue is broken: either the match collapses or price advances without the capitulation signature that defined May 2022, so the pattern-based unknown phase is invalidated.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any session in the next 14 days, or credit spreads (HY OAS) widen by 75 bps or more from today's level.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff-score spike reclassifies the regime as a blowoff rather than an unresolved Luna-style base; a 75 bp spread blowout reclassifies it as stress/breakdown. Either outcome falsifies the moderate 38 score and the UNKNOWN/HOLD stance.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
